plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, suggests that US school programmes for gifted and talented children may have worked, in past decades, as a funnel for finding children with supposed psychic abilities. If so, ordinary education programmes would have doubled as a quiet way to spot recruits for that kind of research.
